proposals.evidence: DEDR 1355 full article (p. 126) gives Kor. (M.) gedda id. Te. (Inscr.) gaḍḍuva-maḍi wet or paddy land; gaṇḍu-maḍi id.; gaṇḍamu a paddyfield. Kui gado muddy, slushy, slimy. Kur. gaddā sediment, alluvium. / ? Cf. Skt. kardama-, karda- Bhat kanda “field” matches Lindgren Koraga kaṇḍa “field” in form and sense; this cross-source match is a candidate lead, with the full DEDR article defining the family. Both source identities and dialect tags are preserved.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 1211 full article (p. 113) gives Kor. (O.) kantappa prostrate; kanti depth; kantri to immerse. DED(S) 1017. Bhat kantappa “prostrate” is the same cited Koraga form and sense; its original dialect:Koraga:onti:Onti uncertain dialect tag is retained. The article is used as family classification, not an independent second attestation of Bhat.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 2023 full article (p. 183) gives 2023 Ta. kai hand, arm; elephant's trunk; handle; ( -pp-, -tt- ) to feed with the hand. Ma. kai, kayyi hand, arm; trunk of elephant; handle; kayyu the hand; kayyāḷ an assistant, helper. Ko. Bhat kay “hand” matches Lindgren Koraga kay “arm or hand” in form and sense; this cross-source match is a candidate lead, with the full DEDR article defining the family. Both source identities and dialect tags are preserved.
